blocks.text: SM Supermalls has been working toward a sustainable future, contributing to parent company SM Prime Holdings, Inc.’s vision of responsible and sustainable development for almost 40 years. Through innovative technologies and operational solutions, it conserves water, improves energy efficiency, and minimizes waste across its properties. Guided by the SM Green Movement, the SM Group’s sustainability platform, SM Supermalls continues to uphold its commitment to translating environmental stewardship into meaningful impact for all. “Generational community impact is the sole driving force behind the SM Green Movement,” said Engr.
